svg.title: Binding energy per nucleon and fusion
svg.desc: Binding energy per nucleon, BE/A, versus mass number A for stable nuclei. A brace spans the light nuclei, from ²H up toward A ≈ 20, labeled “Fusion produces energy”: fusing light nuclei into heavier ones raises BE/A, so mass is converted to energy. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Q ≈ 17.6 MeV, negligible input kinetic energy. Opposite product momenta divide kinetic energy in
inverse proportion to masses, approximated by A: about 3.5 and 14.1 MeV. Positions are schematic.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
